CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation explicitly linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinate sets), an organizational/presentation pattern (grid/coordinate listing) and provenance/status (origin fields) are explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to content organization or access.

C.rationale: Multiple lines explicitly identify contents (red/blue) as coordinate sets for named referents.

D.rationale: Origins and provenance fields explicitly attribute status/process information separately from the coordinate content.

O.rationale: The text states coordinate orientation and provides organized coordinate sets showing how contents are represented/presented for current and candidate referents.
